title: Practice Loop Learner Memory Record
description: Schema for persistent cross-session learner trajectory memory. All data must be pseudonymised — no real names, DOB, NHS numbers, or addresses.

learner_pseudonym.description: A pseudonym or hash provided by the nurse. MUST NOT be a real name or identifier.

programme_year.description: NMC programme year (1 = guided participation, 2 = active with minimal guidance, 3 = autonomous practice).

trajectory.description: Chronological list of Practice Loop session entries for this learner.

date.description: ISO 8601 date of the loop run (e.g. 2026-08-07).

loop.description: The loop skill name that was executed.

proficiencies_mapped.description: NMC proficiency numbers mapped during this session (e.g. P7, P10*, P21).

final_min.description: Lowest 10-point verifier score from the final round.

flags.description: Any escalation or safety flags surfaced during this session.

learning_gaps.description: Identified learning gaps or areas needing development.

strengths.description: Identified strengths or areas of good practice.

assessor_preferences.description: Optional trust-specific or assessor-specific preferences stored for consistency across sessions.

trust_name.description: The NHS Trust or organisation name.

custom_verifier_notes.description: Any trust-specific additions to the standard 10-point verifier.

preferred_phrasing.description: Preferred language style or phrasing standards for outputs.
